label: CODEX CONTINUATION
purpose: Factual original-feature quality census; no refitting, score changes, new data or causal verdict
execution: Parent reviews and independently tests/refutes source, then runs under an external process RSS/wall monitor; helper checks high-water RSS/wall/free disk at admission/series/batch boundaries. Aggregate-only output; no feature archives or duplicated input NPZ.
counter_schema: Exact integer counts per field: denominator, rows, invalid, fallback, strictly_clipped_low, strictly_clipped_high, equal_low_boundary, equal_high_boundary, rows_affected. Element fraction=count/denominator; affected-row fraction=rows_affected/rows; undefined denominator zero=null. Original masks before fill/clip, never sanitized zero or exact boundary as inferred missingness.
limitations: Role observations are reused across models and cells, not independent samples; unique membership support rather than repeated epoch passes. No historical run is included in this request.
volume_none_semantics: volume_loader_returned_none means unchanged D.load_volume returned None for a non-grid input, missing volume column, or swallowed parse/read exception; no actual missing-source or source-prevalence claim. Returned-vector length mismatch is a separate counter.
access_boundary: Admission performs explicit evidence hashing/schema checks before body guard. Immediately after admission, before merged reads/replay/spec enumeration, exact admitted raw/merged/metadata/source reads and interpreter-prefix code/shared-library/certificate resources only. Prediction NPZ/dev-score reads prohibited outside streamed exact-pin integrity hashing; that context ends before any loader may run. All data writes prohibited except exclusive creation of the exact fresh output; caught denials invalidate census. Guard remains active through aggregate output write.

preserved_unexecuted_v1.status: unexecuted pre-review drafts, not a failed historical census

thread_admission: Require nonempty original runtime.base.threads map, every frozen value exactly string 1, and current os.environ equality for every original frozen thread variable. This validates the launch environment; it does not independently measure dynamic library worker counts.
